metric_definitions.identifiable_exact_rule_identification_r: Fraction of identifiable tasks (A, B1_recoverable_noise, E) where the system does not abstain and selects a rule functionally identical to the ground-truth target rule across all canonical probes and held-out test scenes.
metric_definitions.unidentifiable_abstention_rate: Fraction of unidentifiable or unresolvable tasks (D_unidentifiable_ambiguity and B2_unresolvable_contradictory_noise) where the system rightly abstains and blocks promotion.
metric_definitions.false_identification_rate: Fraction of all tasks where the system claims identification (abstained == False) but either the task is unidentifiable or the selected rule disagrees with ground truth.
metric_definitions.mean_interventions_used: Mean number of experimental intervention scenes queried from ExperimentalInterventionOracle per task.
metric_definitions.distinguishing_intervention_rate: Fraction of executed interventions that reduced the surviving hypothesis count or posterior Shannon entropy.
metric_definitions.mean_expected_information_gain_bits: Mean expected Shannon entropy reduction IG(x; H_t) in bits per executed intervention.
metric_definitions.cumulative_entropy_reduction_bits: Sum (and per-task mean) of realized Shannon entropy reductions (H_0 - H_final) in bits across tasks.
metric_definitions.semantic_equivalence_handling_rate: Fraction of Family C tasks where semantically equivalent syntax pairs are detected and resolved to their canonical representative with 0 unnecessary interventions and without claiming unique single-syntax separation.
metric_definitions.noisy_observation_robustness_rate: Fraction of Family B tasks handled according to uncertainty rules: recovering the exact rule via multi-step corroboration on B1_recoverable_single_flip and abstaining/quarantining on B2_unresolvable_contradictory_noise.
metric_definitions.false_promotion_rate: Fraction of tasks where an unvalidated, ambiguous, unidentifiable, or false rule is promoted.
metric_definitions.rollback_success_rate: Fraction of rollback verification drills that restore the exact prior GuardedSkillLibrary version and active skill list.
metric_definitions.m16_m17_regression_rate: Fraction of seeds with any accuracy drop (> 0.0) on locked M16 or M17 regression suites after M18 promotions.

limitations: Candidate experimental interventions are synthesized within a bounded scene DSL (N in [2..6], pos in [0..7], up to 48 candidate scenes per task).
Expected information gain assumes a uniform prior over surviving equivalence classes and a symmetric observation noise parameter.
Semantic equivalence is audited over a finite canonical probe set plus all admissible candidate intervention scenes; undecidable equivalence in unrestricted languages is out of scope.
All experiments run on synthetic relational object scenes on CPU and do not establish general intelligence.
